senses.sense_definition: The belief that something is true based on reasonable evidence.

senses.sense_definition: A legal rule that a fact is accepted as true unless proven otherwise.

senses.sense_definition: The underlying condition or premise upon which a conclusion is built.

examples.text: The entire theory rests on the <w>presumption</w> that resources are infinite.

target_lang_translations.fr: Toute la théorie repose sur le <w>présupposé</w> que les ressources sont infinies.
